title: Two-stage signals: an engine trigger, then a confirmed $15 / $20 move in the SAME direction, then a trade plan with its own stop, target and risk/reward check
status: APPROVED by the operator 2026-11-07 (re-engineering brief); development runs once after this commit; validation opens once, after the development results are committed, for the configurations listed under validation_opening; the holdout opens only for a candidate that passes development AND validation

Create a separate strategy version for this experiment ... Keep the existing live B15 test unchanged"; final instruction "Do not modify production alerts or the existing B15 experiment until I approve the research findings and implementation plan."
source_of_hypothesis: The operator's brief: a BUY / SELL trigger is only an opportunity; the market must then show a confirmed $15-$20 move in the trigger's own direction before a trade plan is made. Statistically this is a time-series momentum (continuation) hypothesis at an intraday horizon: after a confirmed +$15 move, the next +T arrives before -S more often than S / (S + T). Under a driftless random walk the confirmation adds nothing, so every result is compared with the same pipeline run on random triggers (null N2) and with the geometry S / (S + T) (null N1).

data.series: Twelve Data XAU/USD 15min and 1h (research data directory, the same files as B10-B18)
data.validation: 2023-01-24 -> 2024-07-01. Opened once before (B13-1: the engine's 15m signals at +$13 / +$15 before -$13), so for engine-signal triggers it is not fully blind; stated in every report
data.recent: 2026-01-01 -> the last stored bar. Not sealed; partly seen (B9-explore and B12-explore used Sep-Nov 2026); descriptive only
data.scaling: Every distance is dollars at a $4,000 price, scaled by price / 4000 (s = P / 4000), as B4-B18. Costs are dollars per oz, not scaled (today's dollar costs), as B13-B18
data.volume: None stored for 2020-2024: the engine runs on the research Market of quantum.research.b10.make_market (no macro, volume or cross-asset inputs), exactly as B10 / B13-1

stage_a_triggers.ENG: The frozen treatment engine's SIGNAL events (quantum.engine.run, config.DEFAULT) on 15m, 30m (15m resampled to 30min), 1h and 4h (1h resampled on the 17:00 New York grid). Trigger price P0 = the signal bar's close; trigger time = that bar's close.
stage_a_triggers.STR: The engine's own structure events (BOS, MSS, CHoCH) on the same four timeframes, kept when, at that bar, the engine's bias agrees (bull > bear for BUY, bear > bull for SELL), the close is beyond the session VWAP in that direction and session_quality >= 30. Same P0 and time convention.
stage_a_triggers.repeat_rule: Pooled across timeframes in time order; a trigger in the same direction within 4 hours and $15 (scaled) of the P0 of an earlier kept trigger is a REPEAT and dropped (the live alerts' rule A1).
stage_a_triggers.recorded: direction, P0, time, timeframe, engine bull / bear scores, regime label, session label, ATR14, RSI14, EMA20 / 100 / 200, VWAP, the previous day / week high and low

stage_b_confirmation.path: The 15m bars that open at or after the trigger time, up to 96 of them (one trading day). Every condition is evaluated at a bar's CLOSE with data up to that close only.
stage_b_confirmation.milestones: REACHED_15 / REACHED_20: a bar's high (BUY) or low (SELL) touches P0 + d x 15s / 20s. Recorded, never counted as confirmation.
stage_b_confirmation.invalidation: Before confirmation: (a) price: a bar's low (BUY) / high (SELL) reaches P0 - d x 13s; (b) structure: an opposite-direction BOS / MSS / CHoCH on the 15m engine run after the trigger. When a bar both invalidates and closes beyond the threshold, invalidation wins (intrabar order unknown).
stage_b_confirmation.confirmed: CONFIRMED_X (X = 15 or 20): the first bar, not invalidated, whose CLOSE is beyond P0 + d x X s and that passes the filter set. A bar that closes beyond the threshold but fails a filter leaves the status CONFIRMATION PENDING; a later bar can still confirm.

filters.F0: the close beyond the threshold only
filters.F1: F0 and: momentum (RSI14 on 15m >= 55 for BUY, <= 45 for SELL, and the close beyond EMA20 in the direction); structure continuation (at least one same-direction BOS / MSS / CHoCH on the 15m run after the trigger, up to that bar); cost (the model cost at that bar <= $0.80 per oz, i.e. London, New York or a kill zone); volatility (that bar's range <= 2.5 x ATR14 and |open - previous close| <= 0.5 x ATR14, ATR14 on 15m)

entry.E1: market at the confirmation bar's close
entry.E2: limit at the threshold level P0 + d x X s, good for 8 bars after confirmation; filled when a bar trades through it (at the limit, or at the open when a bar opens beyond it in the trade's favour); not filled = MISSED

stop.SATR: 3.0 x ATR14 on 15m at the confirmation bar
stop.SSTR: the structure low (BUY) / high (SELL) of the 15m bars from the trigger to the confirmation bar, minus / plus 0.2 x ATR14

trade_plan.decision: EXECUTE when target / stop distance >= 1.0, the stop distance is within [5s, 40s] and the cost is <= 15% of the stop distance; REJECT otherwise. (WAIT is the live status while confirmation is pending.)
trade_plan.exit: First touch on the 15m bars after entry, up to 192 bars (two trading days). A bar opening beyond a level fills at its open (Amendment 14). A bar touching both levels without opening beyond either is AMBIGUOUS: counted as a loss in every primary figure and reported separately; a sensitivity line excludes it. Neither level in 192 bars = TIMEOUT at that bar's close.
trade_plan.money: net per trade = (exit - entry) x d / s - cost, in $ per oz at $4,000; R = net / (stop distance / s). Cost = the frozen engine cost model (spread + 2 x slippage + commission; about $0.77-$0.97 per oz round trip); the operator's measured $0.26 per oz is a sensitivity line.

strategies_compared.1: Existing engine as alerted: ENG triggers, entry at P0, -$13 / +$13 (the B15 plan); secondary: the engine's own SL / TP1
strategies_compared.2: Trigger only: ENG triggers, entry at P0, S13, T20
strategies_compared.3: $15 confirmation: ENG, X15 F0, E1, S13, T20
strategies_compared.4: $20 confirmation: ENG, X20 F0, E1, S13, T20
strategies_compared.5a: $15 confirmation with momentum and structure filters: ENG, X15 F1, E1, S13, T20
strategies_compared.5b: $20 confirmation with momentum and structure filters: ENG, X20 F1, E1, S13, T20
strategies_compared.STR versions: the same six on STR triggers

nulls.N1: geometry: S / (S + T) and random entries at the same direction mix (quantum.research.b13.random_rates convention)
nulls.N2: the full B19 pipeline (confirmation, filters, plan, exit) on random triggers: every 8th 15m bar of the partition, both directions

primary_test.hypotheses: H1-H4: strategies 3, 4, 5a, 5b on ENG triggers; H5-H8: the same on STR triggers
primary_test.per_hypothesis: mean net $ per trade > 0, one-sided t; AND above the N2 null for the same configuration (one-sided Welch t)
primary_test.family: Holm over H1-H8 at one-sided alpha 0.05 on the expectancy test; a pass also needs the N2 test at 0.05, profit factor >= 1.1 and at least 50 trades. A development pass earns only a place in the validation opening.

grid_secondary.configurations: trigger {ENG, STR} x confirmation {none, X15 F0, X20 F0, X15 F1, X20 F1} x entry {E1, E2; E1 only for none} x stop {S10, S13, SATR, SSTR} x target {T15, T20, T25, T30} = 288
grid_secondary.walk_forward: development only: train 12 months, test the next 6, rolling by 6 months from 2020-04-01; in each train window the configuration with the highest mean net R among those with >= 20 trades is selected and scored on the test window; the concatenated test results are reported
grid_secondary.pbo: CSCV (quantum.research.harness.pbo_cscv), 8 groups over monthly blocks of mean net R per configuration
grid_secondary.dsr: Deflated Sharpe of the best configuration, against the per-trade Sharpe ratios of all 288 configurations; the registry's total trial count is reported beside it
grid_secondary.reality_check: White's Reality Check on monthly mean net R of all 288 configurations against no trade
grid_secondary.monte_carlo: 10,000 resamples of each primary strategy's trade results, 100 trades each: median and 95th percentile maximum drawdown in R, and the probability of a 10 R drawdown (a 10% maximum loss at 1% risk per trade)
grid_secondary.regimes: per trigger, descriptive: trending (regime STRONG TR / EXPANSION), ranging (RANGE / COMPRESS), volatile (ATR14 / price in the partition's top quintile), news (within 2 hours after a CPI / payrolls / FOMC release; B8's calendar, development only)
grid_secondary.reported: triggers, reached $15, reached $20, confirmed, invalidated (price / structure), expired, rejected, missed, trades, TP first, SL first, ambiguous, timeout, profit factor, net expectancy ($ / oz and R), t, maximum drawdown, average holding time, average cost, missed opportunities (triggers whose price reached P0 + d x 30s within the window with no trade taken)

validation_opening.runs_once: after the development results are committed
validation_opening.configurations: strategies 1, 2, 3, 4, 5a, 5b on ENG and STR triggers (declared here, not selected), plus at most two development candidates: grid configurations with t >= 2.0, profit factor >= 1.2, >= 50 trades and a positive walk-forward test mean, ranked by DSR
validation_opening.pass: mean net $ per trade > 0 with one-sided t >= 1.645 and above N2 at 0.05

holdout_opening: Only for a candidate that passes development AND validation; once; same pass rule. Otherwise the holdout stays sealed and the report says so.
power_stated_in_advance: B10 found 70 engine signals on 15m and 25 on 1h in development; with 30m and 4h and the REPEAT rule, ENG may give about 100-150 triggers, of which only part confirm: H1-H4 may well be INSUFFICIENT (< 50 trades). STR is declared for power. A true +$1.5 per trade edge with a standard deviation near $15 needs about 270 trades for 80% power at one-sided 0.05.
secondary_reported_not_decisive: every grid configuration, per timeframe, per regime, ambiguity-excluded and operator-cost sensitivity lines, E2 entries

decision.if_pass_all: A candidate that passes development, validation and the holdout is proposed for a live forward test, registered separately before it starts, with the confirmation panel and alerts. No production change before the operator approves.
decision.if_not: Recorded in research/trials.jsonl and the write-up (research/B19_RESULTS.md). No re-run with changed thresholds, filters, windows or targets on the same data. The confirmation panel may still be offered as a display of measured odds, for the operator to decide.
